nativeFirstFrameMs.$note: The native splash frame only. Kept because it is the figure people quote, and it is the figure that misleads.

jsPhaseMs.howMeasured: lib/startupTiming.ts logs `nexus-startup: … js <n>ms` at the root layout's first commit; read from adb logcat on emulator-5554 (411dp, API 36) after am force-stop, three cold starts
jsPhaseMs.$buildTypeNote: A debug build downloads its bundle from Metro and Hermes must parse JavaScript rather than load bytecode, so a release build should be FASTER than this. Treat it as an upper bound on the JavaScript phase.
jsPhaseMs.$note: Measured from the bundle entry point, which is why index.js exists. Timed from the root layout instead, this read 0ms while the app took seconds to open.
